mechanism: Systemic corticosteroids impair vitamin D metabolism and increase urinary calcium excretion, potentially reducing cholecalciferol efficacy and increasing hypocalcemia risk, though topical ophthalmic prednisolone has minimal systemic absorption.
action: Monitor serum calcium and vitamin D levels periodically; the interaction is unlikely to be clinically significant with ophthalmic prednisolone alone, but counsel patients on adequate calcium intake.
